newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos takes 20 pct of Warim block.
newsitem.headline: Santos takes 20 pct of Warim block.

text.p: Oil and gas producer and explorer Santos Ltd said on Monday it has acquired a 20 percent interest in the Warim production sharing contract in eastern Irian Jaya from Conoco Inc.
Conoco is a subsidiary of DuPont Co.
Santos said the acreage straddles the same thrust and foldbelt in the Papuan Basin, which extends from Papua New Guinea, where the Kutubu and Gobe oil fields are located, into Iran Jaya.
The production sharing contract is operated and 100 percent owned by Conoco.
Santos said it had farmed in for a 20 percent equity interest in a two well programme starting this month.
The first well to be drilled would be Kau-1.
Santos said six wells had been drilled in the area, the last in 1993. Five of the six had encountered oil shows.
